summary: Module 08 BUILD: shipped the production-grade Team Collaboration test + documentation + CI package (Decision B). PART 1 - test suite: added tests/test_module8_permissions.py (15 tests) pinning the admin/member/viewer/owner permission-boundary matrix in BOTH directions (admin can invite/list but cannot change roles or remove members; member/viewer cannot invite, list members, view team audit, or modify roles; owner can do everything; duplicate-invite of an existing member returns 409; viewer cannot comment on a link they don't own). Fixed a CI gap: carol@example.com added to DEV_USERS in api/migrations/migrate.py so fresh databases (CI, Docker) seed the third user my Module 07 role-escalation suite depends on. PART 4 - capstone integration test: tests/test_module8_integration.py runs one continuous journey (A creates team -> A invites B -> B accepts -> B comments with @mention of A -> activity feed shows the comment -> owner audit shows team.created/invitation_created/invitation_accepted, author audit shows comment.created/mention.notification), adapting to the Module 07 link-owner comment scoping. PART 3 - CI: verified .github/workflows/ci.yml already runs postgres:16 + redis:7 services, migrations, full pytest, trigram search-plan assertion, and docker build; installed+started Redis locally (was the cause of the pre-existing full-suite hang) so all 147 tests pass. PART 2 - documentation: docs/API.md (full endpoint reference), docs/SETUP.md (env, DB, worker, tests, Docker, troubleshooting), docs/ADRs.md (ADR-001 owner-scoped comments, ADR-002 owner-only role changes, ADR-003 append-only audit, ADR-004 trigram index). Full suite: 147 passed, 0 failed.
